model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" (y-axis) of various language models across different language families (x-axis), with error bars indicating variability or confidence intervals. The x-axis lists language families in the following order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The y-axis, labeled "effect," is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each language family, there are six grouped bars, each corresponding to a different language model as indicated in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The bars are arranged in the same order for each group, with consistent color coding. The values of the bars vary significantly across language families and models; for example, in the IE-Romance family, the mBERT-R₂ (light green) bar reaches approximately 20, while in the Uralic family, all bars are very low, near 0. In general, the IE-Romance and Semitic families show the highest effects, particularly for the mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ models, while the Uralic and Isolate families exhibit minimal effects across all models. The chart is rotated diagonally, with the x-axis running from bottom-left to top-right, and the y-axis from bottom-right to top-left. No specific bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard error bars and color coding.
